title: Restriction to a localized site preserves quasi-isomorphisms
statement: Let C be any category with Grothendieck topology J, R a sheaf of rings, and U an object of C [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Let t:L′→L be a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] of unbounded cochain complexes of sheaves of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. The termwise restriction functor to sheaves of R|U-modules sends t to a quasi-isomorphism. The explicit zero-morphism-preservation witness only supplies the map-on-complexes construction; it adds no mathematical restriction.

source.place: Section 03DH, restriction j_U^*; exactness recalled in Lemma 18.19.4 (03DK)

proof.text: Restriction retains section modules and their maps on objects (V,f) of C/U. Kernels are sectionwise. Covers of (V,f) correspond to covers of V with their forced maps to U, so local cokernel representatives and local equalities commute with restriction. Thus restriction preserves kernels and cokernels and is additive and exact.

Exact additive functors preserve homology. Apply Mathlib HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_map_of_preservesHomology: each restricted homology map is restriction of an invertible homology map under the natural comparison, and is therefore invertible.

proof_origin.place: Section 03DH, restriction j_U^*; exactness recalled in Lemma 18.19.4 (03DK)

lean.statement:
theorem localizedModule_restriction_quasiIso
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (hzero : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R U).PreservesZeroMorphisms)
    {L' L : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v} R) ℤ}
    (t : L' ⟶ L) [QuasiIso t] :
    letI := hzero
    QuasiIso (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R U).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map t)
